claims.text: Hyperparameters explored include vector dimension size, type of algorithm, and learning rate.
Various dimensions from 50 to 1,000 and vocabulary sizes from 30,000 to 3,000,000 were tested.
The study empirically analyzes optimal combinations of hyper-parameters for embeddings, specifically for word2vec.
